name: A Father's Request and a Daughter's Wish

meals.note: Sha Lan until Support 3 (by 10/14), then Halvin takes her seat. Fillers still short (Nezha, Nuzzuo, Seteth, Jester) first.

weekly.text: The Thermae opens at Renown 8 (usually Ch 10): it raises Support but costs Turns

missables.text: Clear Queen of the Erased by 10/14: Sha Lan can't be recruited without it
missables.lose: The Sha Lan recruit, plus the paralogue's 20,000G and 150 Renown
detail: Window 10/5 to 10/14.
The listed battle deadline is 10/17, but free time ends 10/15.
Renown 8 late? Clear it anyway (its 150 Renown helps) and recruit her in Ch 11 once Renown 8 lands.

note.text: Renown 8 (early to mid Ch 10) opens Advanced: exam in ledger order as each unit shows Lv 35
detail: Sirocco and Olympia usually get there now, Catania now or in Ch 11; Buccar and Guzran in Ch 11.
Inyoni Sniper and Esmeralda Dreadnought follow in Ch 12.
Specialty for any Ch 9 join that missed Lv 20 in Ch 9: Inyoni Archer, Ludia Myrmidon, Halvin Charioteer.

override.text: Physic comes at White Magic B; get it before the Ch 11 battle
White Magic B (Physic) from the Arena Mage course before the Ch 11 battle
Archer (Bow C) before her first map if Ch 9 didn't get her to Lv 20
Myrmidon (Sword C) now if Lv 20 slipped past Ch 9
Charioteer (Rider D, Bow C) now if Ch 9 missed it

buy.text: Archive Γ for Olympia (read it at once), if Vandahl Dagsion lists it from about Ch 10
detail: Death Γ is her crit nuke. Barter cost unknown.

buy.text: Anna's Shop sometimes appears north of Temple Row; its stock rotates
Dagsion Armorer: a [[item:Bronze Spear]] (300G) for Sha Lan's join (10/5 to 10/14)

barter.for: Dadao, only if you skipped Nemea Cavern

assign.why: Leda's Coris Mine copy: Hit +5 on her arts
Io's: Lightning Strike at 1-2 for the armored Ch 10 map
Sha Lan's: magic hit for Part II Ch 5 (Dagda)

note.text: Blacksmith: Sha Lan's [[item:Bronze Spear +4]] on her join, held for 11/27 (Smithing Stone)

recruits.action: Pay 1,500G on 9/28 and bench him: his Levin Sword goes to Sirocco
detail: Filler. No Arena seat; field him in Part II only if a slot opens.

recruits.action: Pay 3,000G once Support 3 lands: filler for Esmeralda, Guzran and Mu
Hand over 5× [[item:Iron Spear]] once Support 3 lands: Catania's only partner
Right after the paralogue, answer Saramis, then Da Mina, then Grounded Ship
recruits.when: Right after Queen of the Erased (by 10/14)
detail: Bench: joins at about Lv 25 in a Specialty class, no exam (the nine slots are set).
She brings a [[item:Salamander]]: hand it to Mu. Give her the Dragonbone Tangle Hexlock Shield.
Short on Support? Ch 11 and Ch 12 still work, as long as the paralogue is cleared.

recruits.action: Talk to her once Renown 8 and Support 3 land: she brings Ursa's Right Claw
detail: Ch 10+ she joins as a Lv 20+ Pugilist with [[item:Ursa's Right Claw]]; earlier, without it.
The Claw is cursed (Curse 1): Anatolia's Part III weapon. Hold it to the end of Part I.
Filler, bench only.

recruits.action: Hand over 3× [[item:Iron Bow]] once Renown 9 lands: he brings a Levin Sword
detail: Filler, bench only.

recruits.action: Hand over 3× Sandworm Meat from [[place:Aditi's Cave]] once Renown 9 lands
detail: Filler for supports with Dadao, Halvin and Sha Lan. Bench only.

prep.text: Ch 10+ recruits join at about Lv 25, already in a Specialty class, with chapter-scaled gear

route.note: Do both dances early: they top you up to Renown 8 for the exams and Sha Lan
detail: 200 Renown, crates and 5,000G each. Due 11/27.

sub.note: Hand over the 2 spare Da Mina weapons from Ch 9
Follows For the Empire's Safety; the other Ch 8 pick gives Assassination (No Questions)

paralogue.note: Finish by 10/14: Sha Lan's recruit needs it
detail: Cure the villagers' confusion, then escort them east, then north, counter-clockwise to the exit.
Leave the pentkehydra: killing it ends the map. Hit the oddly animated worms to stun it.
Kalla's Blessing (Avo +50) helps. Save every villager for a Spellshard and a Dew of Peace.

explore.text: Paralogues and subquest fights: rotate one bench unit into slots 7 to 9 when the holder is ahead
detail: Ludia, Halvin, Jasmine, Fianna in turn; the rest run dungeon parties with a carry.
Aim: the bench near Lv 30 by 11/27 ?

explore.text: Win the Lv 30 Clash at Kalla's Main Temple: [[item:Kalla's Bow]] (Bow A) for Inyoni's Part III
detail: Leda and Halvin also use bows; the Bow A gate makes it Inyoni's Part III bow.

explore.text: Gather Shem Yam ×3 and Desert Millet ×5 for Catania's Talisman Shield
detail: Blue Ginji ×3 for Jasmine's Victory Gem: Vandahl Gaura Grassland takes the barter.

explore.text: Skipped [[place:Nemea Cavern]] (Lv 30) in Ch 9? Run it now: Dadao's second Hammer, Jasmine's manual

tips.text: Most enemies are armored: Esmeralda's [[item:Hammer]], Guzran's [[item:Flyssa]] or magic
Sirocco (Io's [[item:Levin Sword]]) and Olympia's Thoron hit Res; dance Esmeralda after Hammer kills
When Theodora threatens Earthen Hurl, pull the lever
Pack: Catania a [[item:Ji]]; Sirocco's Levin Sword (Wt 8) in hand only on turns he ends out of reach
